subject: Shiny widget on top of plot inside a box?

messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: Shiny widget on top of plot inside a box?
parts:
Hi everyone,

Suppose I have the following shiny dashboard:

## app.R ##
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(ggplot2)

header <- dashboardHeader()

sidebar <- dashboardSidebar()

body <- dashboardBody(box(
  title = "Test", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
  checkboxInput("test", "test widget", value = FALSE, width = NULL),
  plotOutput("plot1", height = 250)
),
box()
)

ui <- dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
     ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

I would like to position my checkboxInput on the top right corner of the graph (inside the gray area). Is this possible?

I thought about using an absolutePanel, but I'm not sure how ## app.R ## library(shiny) library(shinydashboard) library(ggplot2)

header <- dashboardHeader()

sidebar <- dashboardSidebar()

body <- dashboardBody(box(
  title = "Test", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
  absolutePanel(id = "controls", class = "panel panel-default", fixed = TRUE,
                draggable = TRUE, top = 60, left = "auto", right = 20, bottom = "auto",
                width = 330, height = "auto",
                checkboxInput("test", "test widget", value = FALSE, width = NULL),
                plotOutput("plot1", height = 250)
  )
),
box()
)

ui <- dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Thanks!
